age.title: What year were you born?
age.subtitle: We ask so we can set the right privacy defaults. We never ask for your full date of birth.
age.label: Birth year

errors.required: Enter the year you were born.
errors.implausible: That doesn't look right. Check the year and try again.

blocked.title: You'll need to wait a little
blocked.body: CodeSprint is for learners aged {{minAge}} and over, so we can't set up an account yet. Nothing has been saved, and you're welcome back when you're old enough.

experience.title: How much programming have you done?
experience.subtitle: This only decides where we suggest you start. Every lesson stays open to you.

beginner.label: Beginner
beginner.description: I've tried a little, but I'm not confident yet.

intermediate.label: Intermediate
intermediate.description: I've written programs in some language before.

motivation.title: What brings you here?
motivation.subtitle: We use this to keep the encouragement relevant.

career.label: Career
career.description: Changing jobs or growing in one.

personal.label: Personal interest
personal.description: I just want to learn it.

improve.label: Getting better
improve.description: I code already and want to sharpen up.

goal.title: How much time each day?
goal.subtitle: Consistency beats length. You can change this whenever you like.

5.label: 5 minutes
5.description: A lesson a day. The easiest habit to keep.

reminder.title: When should we nudge you?
reminder.subtitle: A reminder at the same time each day is the single biggest thing that keeps a streak alive.
reminder.explanation: We'll ask permission to send notifications only if you pick a time. You can turn them off in Settings at any point.

consent.title: A couple of privacy choices
consent.subtitle: You can change both of these in Settings later.

analytics.label: Help improve CodeSprint
analytics.description: Share anonymous usage data so we can see which lessons confuse people. Never your answers, your email or your name.

consent.minorNotice: Because you're under {{protectionAge}}, we've already turned analytics off, kept you off the public leaderboard, and limited ads to non-personalised ones. You don't need to do anything.
consent.adsNote: If you're in the EU, UK or Switzerland, we'll ask separately about ads before you see one.
